annotations.title: Deferred x402 Escrow Call with Schema & Failover

description: Execute a paid x402 API request protected by NullClear deferred non-custodial EIP-3009 escrow, custom JSON Schema/value invariants, multi-seller failover routing, and outbound spend caps (10 free trials/day, then requires configured wallet key). Settles upstream payment ONLY when all schema, numeric, staleness, and refusal checks pass; otherwise voids authorization ($0 lost). Use this instead of nullclear_fetch_guarded whenever calling third-party x402 paid APIs with strict output contracts or fallback sellers.

fallbacks.description: Up to 3 ordered backup seller objects ({ targetUrl, sellerAgentId, paymentSignatureHeader }) for automatic failover

invariants.description: Field-level semantic invariants (numeric bounds, regex, forbidden substrings, timestamp freshness)

jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema Draft-07 object that upstream JSON must strictly satisfy

rejectRefusals.description: Void settlement if response contains canonical LLM refusal strings (default true)

requiredFields.description: Dot-notation field paths that must exist in upstream JSON

sellerAgentId.description: ERC-8004 seller agent ID for pre-flight trust and Sybil gating

spendPolicy.description: Outbound spend firewall caps ({ maxPerCallAtomic, maxDailyWalletAtomic })

targetUrl.description: Primary upstream HTTPS endpoint demanding HTTP 402 payment

name: nullclear_execute_escrow
